metadata.description: AG-UI spec exercising the full tool-call event path: START -> ARGS -> END -> RESULT, plus step lifecycle and reasoning events. Added by p7-02 to close a corpus blind spot — no prior example referenced TOOL_CALL_ARGS, which is why the schema shipped the non-existent kind TOOL_CALL_ARGS_DELTA undetected.
metadata.author: prometheus-skill-pack

agent.name: invoice-extraction-agent
agent.description: Extracts structured line items from an uploaded invoice, streaming tool arguments as they are constructed so the UI can preview the extraction before it completes.

tools.name: extract_line_items
tools.description: Parse an invoice document into structured line items.

document_id.description: Identifier of the uploaded invoice document.

currency_hint.description: Expected currency code, used to disambiguate ambiguous symbols.

tools.name: reconcile_totals
tools.description: Check that extracted line items sum to the stated invoice total.

event_emission.condition: Emitted when the extraction step begins. Marks the step active in the multi-step progress rail.
Emitted when the tool call opens. Renders an empty argument preview ready to receive streamed deltas.

Emitted for each incremental argument delta. The event carries a `delta` field, but the event kind itself is TOOL_CALL_ARGS — not TOOL_CALL_ARGS_DELTA. This binding is the regression guard for that distinction.
Emitted when argument streaming completes. Freezes the preview and shows a spinner while the tool executes.
Emitted when the tool returns. Populates LineItemTable with the extracted rows.
Emitted when the extraction step completes. Marks the step done in the progress rail.
Emitted when the agent begins explaining a totals discrepancy. Opens the rationale disclosure.
Emitted for each reasoning delta. Appended to the rationale body.
Emitted when the rationale is complete. Collapses the disclosure to a one-line summary.
Emitted with the reconciliation verdict. Renders a pass/fail badge beside the invoice total.
